data_description.retry_count: Retries after the first send. 0 disables retries; higher values retry failed chunks or whole writes when needed.
data_description.write_delay_ms: Delay between PANDA preamble packets. Image chunks wait for device progress notifications.
data_description.prevent_duplicate_send: Skip guarded writes when the new image is identical to the last rendered image.
data_description.debounce_ms: Delay before writing to the device. New guarded writes cancel pending ones. 0 = disabled.
